_comment: Editorial content for SAPT. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: the company's own mill photographs carry no licence we can record. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: Sapphire Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 11 March 1969 and is the flagship company of the Sapphire Group. It is a vertically integrated composite textile unit manufacturing cotton yarn, fabric and home textile products, with 139,433 spindles, 3,120 rotors, 360 looms and 215 stitching machines across units in Sindh and Punjab. Its processed fabric unit is a joint venture with Carrington Textiles.
headOffice: 20th Floor, Ocean Tower, Plot G-3, Khayaban-e-Iqbal, Block 9, Clifton, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: http://sapphire.com.pk/stml/ (composite unit, capacity), http://www.sapphire.com.pk/stml/offices.htm (head office, telephone), https://sapphiretextiles.com.pk/at-a-glance (product range, processed fabric joint venture with Carrington Textiles) and the PSX company profile for SAPT at https://dps.psx.com.pk/company/SAPT (incorporation, principal activities, CEO) (accessed 2026-10-17)
